description: GlassTube is a SwiftUI YouTube wrapper for macOS with Liquid Glass chrome.

The browser frame gets out of the way: glass toolbars, per-site theming, and tabs that feel like the system. The Xcode project uses file-system-synchronized folders, so the codebase stays as small as the app feels.

download.label: No build yet
download.note: GlassTube is ad-hoc signed for local use only — no distributable build yet.

features.body: YouTube in a native SwiftUI window with floating glass toolbars.

features.body: Themes that follow the video page instead of fighting it.
